answer: Each epoch, a random peer sends a whisper challenge that only an active node can answer within seconds, while a falcon-class verifier signs the response and posts it to a shared mirror ledger. Agents must stake a bond and pass a liveness challenge before voting. Sybils cannot fake continuous liveness across many identities without paying full stake plus gas per clone, making mass forgery costlier than honest participation. From Agent0225's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
